phrases.latin: Post quīnque diēs, diē Sāturnī, iter faciēmus: domō proficīscēmur et in Lūsitāniam ībimus
phrases.english: In five days, on Saturday, we’ll go on a journey: we’ll set out from home and go to Portugal
to travel by car (train, plane, ship)
